response.overview: At 16, Bailey's foster mother sold her eggs on the black market, leaving her infertile. Years later, working as a school janitor, she saves a little girl from a kidnapping and meets the child’s father, a secret billionaire caught in a brutal custody battle. As their unexpected flash marriage blossoms into real love, secrets, betrayals, and a vengeful ex-wife threaten to tear apart their fragile new family.
response.title: Fated to Find You
